analysis.summary: The customer initiated the call expressing extreme frustration over recurring slow internet speeds, impacting online meetings. The agent apologized multiple times, acknowledged the issue, and promised to prioritize the complaint with an update within 24 hours, but did not provide a complaint reference number. The customer threatened to switch service providers if the issue persists.

compliance_violations.description: The agent acknowledged the customer's complaint and provided an expected resolution timeline but failed to provide a docket/complaint reference number as required by TRAI guidelines.
compliance_violations.evidence: We will prioritize your complaint and update you within 24 hours.
compliance_violations.policy_reference: TRAI-004 — Complaint Acknowledgment: When a customer files a complaint, the agent must provide a docket/complaint reference number and inform about expected resolution timeline as per TRAI guidelines.
compliance_violations.recommended_action: Agents must be trained to provide a complaint reference number for every registered complaint.

compliance_violations.description: The agent did not inform the customer that the call was being recorded for quality and training purposes.
compliance_violations.evidence: No statement regarding call recording was made by the agent.
compliance_violations.policy_reference: TRAI-007 — Call Recording Disclosure: Customer must be informed that the call is being recorded for quality and training purposes.
compliance_violations.recommended_action: Agents should be reminded to include the call recording disclosure at the beginning of every call.

improvements: Attempt to offer immediate troubleshooting or a more concrete resolution path

call_outcome.reason: The agent promised an update within 24 hours, indicating the issue was not resolved during the call and requires further action.

Consider a retention offer or a goodwill gesture to prevent churn.
